items.title: The Hotel Industry Has A Water Problem
items.summary: Summer heat and drought brought hospitality’s use of water into sharp focus. The industry is betting on simple fixes like aerated showerheads and less laundry — the question is whether more structural but costly measures can scale.

items.title: AI Will Know Your Travelers. And the World’s Travelers. Will You?
items.summary: AI discovery is moving closer to transaction. Travel brands must become legible to machines without surrendering the memory, service, and loyalty advantages that set them apart.

items.title: The Sustainable Traveler Is More Mainstream Than the Industry Thinks
items.summary: There's a widespread misconception about travelers looking for sustainable options. Rather than being vanishingly rare earnest eco-seekers, there are part of the mainstream and often pragmatic in their choices.

items.title: Europe Wants Tourists Beyond Big Cities. AI Search Stands in the Way.
items.summary: Europe’s overtourism fix depends on two systems it doesn’t control: AI search that favors the obvious, and overly complicated transport that discourages the curious from visiting less familiar places.

items.title: Agoda Doubles Premium Hotel Supply as Five-Star Search Rises
items.summary: Agoda has doubled its luxury supply and five-star searches are rising. Until it shows bookings, there’s no hard proof the platform can sell luxury.

items.title: Vrbo Exempts Some Properties From Losing Subscription Plans: Scoop
items.summary: With some hosts and property managers upset about being unable to renew or convert to subscriptions, Vrbo should be more transparent about why some listings qualify for an exemption while others don't.

items.title: Louvre Closed, Travel Warnings Mount: What France’s Protests Mean for Tourists
items.summary: Governments are updating their travel guidance as protests spread across Europe. The question for travel is whether unrest will continue beyond region's shoulder season.

items.title: Kempinski Faces Leadership Upheaval as CEO and Senior Executives Depart: Scoop
items.summary: Kempinski’s leadership upheaval raises questions about who will carry out its luxury turnaround and how it will be funded.
